message.content:
Lasagna is a classic Italian dish that layers pasta sheets with rich sauces, cheeses, and often meat or vegetables. While there are many variations, here’s a basic recipe for a traditional meat lasagna:

### Ingredients

| Category | Item | Quantity (for 8–10 servings) |
|----------|------|------------------------------|
| **Pasta** | Lasagna noodles (no-boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat Sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef and pork) | 1–1.5 lb (450–680 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Canned crushed tomatoes | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Red wine (optional) | ½ cup (120 ml) |
| | Olive oil | 2 Tbsp |
| | Dried oregano | 1 tsp |
| | Dried basil | 1 tsp |
| | Salt & pepper | to taste |
| | Sugar (optional, to balance acidity) | ½ tsp |
| **Ricotta Mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg | 1 (helps bind) |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Fresh parsley, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt & pepper | to taste |
| **Bechamel Sauce** | Butter | 4 Tbsp |
| | All-purpose flour | 4 Tbsp |
| | Milk | 4 cups (960 ml) |
| | Nutmeg (freshly grated) | pinch |
| | Salt & pepper | to taste |
| **Cheeses** | Mozzarella, shredded | 2–3 cups (200–300 g) |
| | Grated Parmesan (for topping) | ½ cup (50 g) |
| **Optional Add‑ons** | Spinach, sautéed | 2 cups |
| | Mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup |
| | Ricotta or cottage cheese | ½ cup (optional for extra creaminess) |

### Quick Notes

- **No‑boil noodles** save time; just add a little extra liquid to the sauce so they soften during baking.
- **Meat sauce** can be made vegetarian by omitting the meat and adding extra veggies or lentils.
- **Bechamel** adds creaminess; if you’re short on time, you can skip it and use extra ricotta instead.

Enjoy building your lasagna! If you’d like a step‑by‑step cooking guide or substitutions, just let me know.
